summary: Minimal intent-to-implementation handoff for AI4X remote MCP boundary and explicit acceptance baseline.

explicitTestcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_catalog_exposes_available_data_range
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Invoke MCP tools/list and tools/call for ai4x_query command=catalog against the registered remote endpoint.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: Catalog payload returns non-empty databases and total_databases equals databases length.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: Catalog contract is read-only and must remain reachable through canonical remote MCP boundary.

explicitTestcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_query_tool_returns_real_data_payload
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Invoke ai4x_query command=query with selected sourceId and cypher payload through MCP.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: Response source_id matches request and includes valid items/count semantics.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: Unified query behavior stays on canonical ai4x_query remote MCP tool.

explicitTestcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_opencti_schema_detail_supports_progressive_disclosure
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Invoke ai4x_query command=schema then command=detail for one schema-exposed detail pointer.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: Schema response exposes detail pointers and detail response matches requested detail kind and type.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: OpenCTI progressive disclosure remains externally observable through remote MCP contract.

explicitTestcases.name: test_ai4x_platform_data_consumption_flow_uses_real_ai4x_service
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Trigger real OPENCODE flow in registered MCP environment and collect session tool activity.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: Completed ai4x_query catalog/schema/query chain is present in session activity.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: End-to-end data consumption must use canonical remote AI4X boundary instead of local wrapper direct calls.

explicitTestcases.name: test_opencode_app_contains_local_tool_runtime_dependencies
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Read opencode workspace config and workspace contract, then inspect required isolated runtime dependency paths.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: Remote MCP declaration and fallback constraints are present, and required local runtime assets exist.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: Local runtime dependencies are support-only and must coexist with canonical ai4x_query remote MCP boundary.

frozenBaselines: Canonical AI4X tool name is ai4x_query.
Explicit acceptance entrypoints remain in tests/test_ai4x_platform_integration.py and tests/test_opencode_workspace_config.py.
Workspace remote MCP registration remains canonical in agent_app/opencode_app/.opencode/opencode.json and workspace.contract.json.

openQuestions.question: Should implementation architecture freeze a single canonical assertion for MCP tool_names across all guard tests?
openQuestions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, freeze ai4x_query as the canonical value and align all architecture guards to it.
openQuestions.reason: Current guard expectations differ and create avoidable contract drift risk.

notes: This handoff is intentionally minimal and scoped to AI4X boundary contracts.
Business scenario expansion is deferred to later intent iterations after baseline stabilization.
